domain: Two lowercase English strings, each length1..100000.
local_effect_policy: read-only arguments; fresh mutable returns and no output-to-input aliases; explicit local policy, not official mutation requirement
objective: Delete characters of t so remaining t is a subsequence of s; minimize span from first to last deleted index, zero if no deletions.
result_comparison: exact typed value; JS2569 canonical BigInt tags normalize to exact integers only
result_semantics: Delete characters of t so remaining t is a subsequence of s; minimize span from first to last deleted index, zero if no deletions.

source_complexity_review.property: Earliest matched prefix plus latest matched suffix with monotonic pointers, O(len(s)+len(t)) time and O(len(t)) space.
source_complexity_review.status: both exact owner sources statically reviewed, not executed
